# `<`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
expr1 < expr2
```

Returns true if `expr1` is less than `expr2`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT 1 < 2;
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT 1.1 < '1';
```

Result:

```text
false
```

```sql
SELECT to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52') < to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52');
```

Result:

```text
false
```

```sql
SELECT to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52') < to_date('2009-08-01 04:17:52');
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT 1 < NULL;
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```
